AADHAAR.name: Aadhaar Number (UIDAI)
AADHAAR.description: 12-digit Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) citizen identity number. Must not start with 0 or 1. Validated via Verhoeff dihedral group D5 checksum.

PAN.name: Permanent Account Number (PAN)
PAN.description: 10-character alphanumeric Indian Income Tax identifier. 4th char is entity status (P=Person, C=Company, H=HUF, F=Firm, A=AOP, T=Trust, B=BOI, L=Local, J=Artificial, G=Govt). 5th char is surname initial.

PASSPORT_IN.name: Indian Passport Number
PASSPORT_IN.description: 8-character Indian Passport number starting with an uppercase letter (excluding Q, X, Z), followed by 7 digits.

VOTER_ID_IN.name: Election Photo Identity Card (Voter ID / EPIC)
VOTER_ID_IN.description: 10-character Electoral Photo ID Card (EPIC) with 3 uppercase letters followed by 7 numeric digits.

DRIVING_LICENSE_IN.name: Indian Driving Licence (DL)
DRIVING_LICENSE_IN.description: Indian Driving Licence number conforming to Sarathi format (2-letter state code + 2-digit RTO + 4-digit issue year + 7-digit unique number).

GSTIN.name: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN)
GSTIN.description: 15-character alphanumeric GST identifier (2-digit State code + 10-char PAN + 1-char entity number + Z + 1-char Mod 36 checksum).

BANK_ACCOUNT_IN.name: Indian Bank Account Number
BANK_ACCOUNT_IN.description: Indian Core Banking System (CBS) bank account number (9 to 18 digits) preceded or surrounded by banking account context markers.

IFSC.name: Indian Financial System Code (IFSC)
IFSC.description: 11-character code for electronic payment systems (NEFT, RTGS, IMPS). First 4 letters bank code, 5th character must be 0, last 6 branch code.

MICR.name: Magnetic Ink Character Recognition (MICR) Code
MICR.description: 9-digit numeric code printed on cheques (3-digit City code + 3-digit Bank code + 3-digit Branch code).

UPI_VPA.name: Unified Payments Interface Virtual Payment Address (UPI VPA)
UPI_VPA.description: Virtual Payment Address used for real-time payments across NPCI Unified Payments Interface network.

CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD.name: Payment Card Number (RuPay / Visa / Mastercard / Amex)
CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD.description: 13-16 digit payment card primary account number (including Indian RuPay prefixes 5085-5089, 6069, 6070-6079, 6080-6084, 6521-6531) validated via Luhn algorithm.

CARD_CVV.name: Card Verification Value (CVV / CVC / CID)
CARD_CVV.description: 3 or 4 digit security code printed on payment cards. Strictly forbidden from storage and transmission under RBI mandates.

PHONE_IN.name: Indian Mobile / Telephone Number
PHONE_IN.description: 10-digit Indian telephone number starting with digits 6, 7, 8, or 9, with optional +91 or 0 country/trunk prefix.

PIN_CODE_IN.name: Postal Index Number (PIN Code)
PIN_CODE_IN.description: 6-digit Indian Postal Index Number. 1st digit designates postal zone (1-9), followed by sub-zone, sorting district, and delivery post office.

CIN_IN.name: Corporate Identification Number (CIN)
CIN_IN.description: 21-digit alphanumeric number issued by Ministry of Corporate Affairs (Listing status [L/U] + 5-digit Industry code + 2-letter State code + 4-digit Incorporation year + 3-letter Company type + 6-digit Registration number).
